transcript: Place a clove of garlic on your navel tonight. It may sound strange, but this gesture is more powerful than you imagine. Your navel was your first channel of life. It was through it that you received nourishment, oxygen, and also the emotional charge of everything happening around you, even before you were born. It is not just a mark on the body, it is the oldest point of connection you have with life. And for that reason, it remains one of the most receptive points on the human body. Even in adulthood, garlic is one of the most powerful natural elements for cleansing and protection that exist. It has been used for thousands of years in traditions around the world. It dissolves what is stagnant, purifies what is heavy, and protects what is vulnerable. When you place it on the navel with intention, it acts directly on the center of the body, on the point where everything began. Take a small clove of garlic and peel it. Place it in the center of your navel and secure it with a piece of medical tape so it does not fall off while you sleep. Before going to bed, place your hand over your navel for a few seconds. Close your eyes and say in silence, I release what is being held. I let go of what is not mine. I open space for what is coming. Leave it there all night. In the morning, remove the garlic and throw it away outside the house, in the street or in the earth, never in the trash inside. Do this for seven nights in a row. What begins to change in your energy, in your sleep, and in that feeling of lightness over the days, will show you that the navel holds far more than you ever imagined and keep this ritual to yourself while you are doing it. What you protect in silence works with greater force. Write in the comments, I start today. If you are going to do this tonight and come back in seven days to tell me what changed, and if you feel that it's not just your navel that needs cleansing, but everything you have been carrying from long before you can even remember, the emotions you inherited, the stress you absorbed, the weight you carry without knowing where it comes from. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to release exactly that, and everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
